zones: any zone from which the exact selected face is otherwise authorized to be cast
objects: nonland card face carrying the precompiled printed Flash ability
state_reads: priority already granted to the caster
timing: the selected spell may be cast whenever its controller could cast an instant
hidden_information: a hand card remains visible only to its owner until it is cast
layers: only printed Flash compiled for the selected face is represented; granted, removed, and conditional abilities remain unsupported
copy: this contract does not grant Flash to spell copies or copied cards without a face-pinned compiled permission
zone_change: Flash changes timing but never grants permission to cast from a zone

variants: Flash does not allow a land to be played on another player's turn
conditional and as-though-Flash wording remains residual
